$comment: What `bowire scan --suite owasp-api --severity medium` must find against a
freshly started Sample.Rest. Read by scripts/ci/assert-scan-findings.mjs from
This is a fixture, not a security report. A finding listed here is one we
have looked at and decided is either an artefact of running a dev server in
CI, or a known property of a deliberately simple sample. Listing it means
'we know, and we want to be told if this changes' — in EITHER direction.
Changing this file is the interesting moment. Adding an entry should mean a
new probe started firing; removing one should mean the sample was fixed. If
you find yourself editing it to make a red build green without knowing which
of the two happened, that is the bug.

expected.why: The sample binds plain http:// on localhost (samples/…/Program.cs: UseUrls). True of any dev server and not a property of Bowire — but if it ever STOPS firing, the built-in TLS check has regressed.
The sample has no rate limiting. Accurate, and worth keeping visible: an embedding host inherits this shape unless it adds its own.
